### 1 — Scene
A small leafy salad with shredded carrot, blueberries, a few seeds, and a glossy dressing.

### 2 — Vessel
Rounded-square dinner plate, approximately **26 cm across**. Using the requested circular approximation:
**Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm².**

### 3 — Items
Mixed salad leaves with reddish stems, shredded carrot, blueberries, a few pumpkin-like seeds, and visible dressing. Dressing composition is uncertain; I estimate a light oil-based dressing.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Area shares below partition the food’s footprint rather than counting overlapping ingredients twice.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Mixed leaves | 34% | 181 cm² × 2.5 cm = 452 ml | 0.15 g/ml | 68 g | 20 | 14 kcal |
| Shredded carrot | 5% | 27 cm² × 0.6 cm = 16 ml | 0.6 g/ml | 10 g | 41 | 4 kcal |
| Blueberries | 3% | 16 cm² × 1.2 cm = 19 ml | 0.65 g/ml | 12 g | 57 | 7 kcal |
| Seeds | 1% | 5.3 cm² × 0.3 cm = 1.6 ml | 0.6 g/ml | 1 g | 560 | 6 kcal |
| Dressing | Overlay; no additional footprint | 228 cm² × 0.03 cm film ≈ 7 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 7 g | 450 | 32 kcal |

**Coverage check:** 34% + 5% + 3% + 1% = **43%**, consistent with the salad occupying mainly the upper-right portion of the plate.

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **98 g and 63 kcal** is plausible for this modest, airy salad. The dressing is the largest source of energy uncertainty.
